load_audio: load audio from a file path or bytes into a CPU or CUDA buffer with optional decoding config
load_video: load video from a file path or bytes into a CPU or CUDA buffer with optional timestamp window
load_image: load an image from a file path or bytes into a CPU or CUDA buffer with optional filter
load_image_batch: batch load multiple images into a single buffer with optional resizing and pixel format conversion
save_image: save a numpy array as an image file with configurable pixel format and encoding options
